label: software regression
requirements: component tests; deterministic integration; artifact hashes

label: protocol-compatible sensitivity
requirements: exact published controller parameters; declared substitute path inputs and/or geometries; sensitivity analysis
allowed_claim: behavior under explicitly declared protocol-compatible sensitivity conditions

label: condition-faithful reproduction
requirements: published environment coordinates; cited static path model reconstructed; published start/path pairing protocol; compatible controller implementations
allowed_claim: comparison with published behavioral patterns after path-model gate passes

label: numerical replication
requirements: original exact path instances/seeds and implementation artifacts or fully specified equivalent
